The '''1979–80 [[La Liga]]''' season was the 49th since its establishment. It began on 8 September 1979, and concluded on 18 May 1980.

[[Real Madrid C.F.|Real Madrid]] achieved their 20th title. They also won the [[1979-80 Copa del Rey|Copa del Rey]] against their reserve team, [[Real Madrid Castilla|Castilla CF]]; thus Castilla qualified for [[1980-81 European Cup Winners' Cup|next season's Cup Winners Cup]].

== Overview ==
Once finished the championship on June 20, 1980, the Competition Committee of the Royal Spanish Football Federation quashed the game of the 31st round between [[CD Málaga|Málaga]] and [[UD Salamanca|Salamanca]] (0–3), considering that it had been rigged, and sanctioned the salmantino club with the deduction of two points. Thus, [[UD Salamanca|Salamanca]] ended in the 14th position with 30 points and with a record of 12 wins, 8 draws and 13 defeats in 33 games, totaling 34 goals for and 37 against. However, a year later, on May 8, 1981, the Higher Committee of Sports Justice of the Superior Sports Council overturned the sanctions due to lack of evidence.
